websearch.description: Standalone web search queries needed to answer the user, resolved of pronouns/context. Empty array if none needed.

doc_retrieval.description: Queries to run against attached documents. Empty array if no documents are relevant or none were attached.

rag_retrieval.description: Queries to run against the long-term RAG knowledge base. Empty array if not needed.

user_preferences.description: New or changed preferences belonging to the user (or a closely related person the user explicitly ties to their own decisions). Do not include third-party opinions mentioned only in passing.

id.description: Existing id if updating, otherwise a new short id.

subject.description: Who the preference belongs to, usually 'user'.

replaces.description: Id of the existing preference this supersedes, required if action is 'update'.

user_decisions.description: New or changed decisions the user has committed to going forward.

replaces.description: Id of the existing decision this supersedes, required if action is 'update'.

user_events.description: Things that happened to or were done by the user (outcomes already occurred, good or bad). Not forward-looking.

user_tasks.description: Work the user started, is planning, or is deferring to another time.

replaces.description: Id of the existing task this supersedes, required if action is 'update'.
